high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme that depicts a scene of early humans in a natural outdoor setting. The text at the top reads, "Shout out to all the early humans who lost their lives figuring out which plants were edible." In the foreground, there is a person with long, wavy hair, wearing what appears to be a fur garment, holding a piece of food and looking distressed or surprised. This individual seems to be reacting to the food they are about to eat. In the background, two other individuals are sitting on the ground near a small fire.
